Retrieved 2026-07-19 via Exa. Independent published 2026-07-15 16:55 BST; i published 2026-07-15.

Shabana Mahmood expected to be named Burnham's chancellor.
- Home Secretary Mahmood widely expected to be named chancellor after Burnham's inner circle objected to his original choice, Ed Miliband (The Independent understands).
- Mahmood seen as chancellor who will "keep the markets calm"; on the right of the party; previously endorsed by Sir Tony Blair as a potential party leader.
- Ed Miliband likely to become foreign secretary (i Paper). Cabinet line-up unlikely finalised until hours before Burnham takes over Monday 20 July.
- i Paper: senior Cabinet positions "pretty much locked in now". A source close to Burnham (The Independent): "Shabana is in the driving seat for the job. It won't be Ed now. But Andy is going to do things differently from before."
- Also in frame historically: Yvette Cooper (Foreign Sec), Wes Streeting, Darren Jones. Rachel Reeves (UK's first woman chancellor) lobbying to keep job but highly unlikely to stay.
- BBC (ceqe55d0q9po, 15 July): chancellor pick "will send a signal of his intent both to politicians and to the bond markets"; "live discussions" over installing Mahmood in No 11; Yvette Cooper also potential occupant; announcements not expected until Monday.
